weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: four interacting deposition families (two cationic polymers, a film former, shea butter) make bounded residue plausible even though all are listed late; the C1 reset is effective, so nothing points to high.
weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition routes are post-Parfum (@10-19) and plausibly small; shea butter is non-material under W-LINE; strong-ish AOS reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two cationic polymers, a film-forming polyester and shea butter converge (W2); calling it lightweight would understate the combined residue risk.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: four distinct deposition families including two cationic polymers and a film former (W2) - a lateness argument alone does not establish that the combined residue stays below noticeable. Not high: no material payload lipid (shea after the W-line @7), no W-RICH, effective C1 reset.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Late positions of every deposition route; low/moderate boundary.
